notes.title: Spaceman Memories Demo Launch + PC Specs
notes.content:
[h3][b]🗓 Demo Launches on September 19th[/b][/h3][h3]After a lot of focused solo work the first demo of [i]Spaceman Memories[/i] is almost ready. I'm very sorry for the delays throughout September as I had announced previously it would release on the first week of September, don't want to make excuses but I'm a one man team and I've been squashing a lot of bugs that I encountered almost at launch.[/h3][p]If you’re planning to check it out, here are the system requirements for both Windows and SteamOS/Linux so you know what to expect.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Windows system requirements[/b][/h3][p]✅ Minimum Requirements[/p][list][*][p][b]OS[/b]: Windows 10 (64-bit)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Processor[/b]: AMD Ryzen 3 3100 / Intel Core i3-9100[/p][/*][*][p][b]Memory[/b]: 8 GB RAM[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics[/b]: NVIDIA GTX 1650 / AMD RX 6500 XT[/p][/*][*][p][b]DirectX[/b]: Version 12 (Shader Model 6 required)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Storage[/b]: 5 GB available space[/p][/*][*][p][b]Note[/b]: SSD strongly recommended[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🔷 Recommended Requirements[/p][list][*][p][b]OS[/b]: Windows 11 (64-bit)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Processor[/b]: Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i5-10400[/p][/*][*][p][b]Memory[/b]: 16 GB RAM[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics[/b]: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6600 XT[/p][/*][*][p][b]DirectX[/b]: Version 12 (Shader Model 6 required)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Storage[/b]: 5 GB available space[/p][/*][*][p][b]Note[/b]: SSD strongly recommended[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]SteamOS/Linux Requirements[/b][/h3][p]Spaceman Memories runs very well on Steam Deck. Performance is smooth, and the entire demo is fully playable with a controller. All core features—movement, combat, menus, and dialogue—work seamlessly with gamepad input, making it a great experience in handheld mode or docked.[/p][p]✅ Minimum[/p][list][*][p][b]OS[/b]: SteamOS 3.0 / Linux (Arch, Ubuntu 22.04+, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Processor[/b]: AMD Zen 2 / AMD Ryzen 3 5300U or Intel Core i5-9400 or better[/p][/*][*][p][b]Memory[/b]: 16 GB RAM[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics[/b]: AMD RDNA2 GPU (Steam Deck) or NVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX 2060 or AMD RX 6600[/p][/*][*][p][b]Storage[/b]: 5 GB available space[/p][/*][*][p][b]Note[/b]: SSD strongly recommended[/p][/*][/list][p]🔷 Recommended[/p][list][*][p][b]OS[/b]: SteamOS 3.0 / Linux (Arch, Ubuntu 22.04+, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Processor[/b]: AMD Zen 2 / AMD Ryzen 3 5300U or Intel Core i5-9400 or better[/p][/*][*][p][b]Memory[/b]: 16 GB RAM[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics[/b]: AMD RDNA2 GPU (Steam Deck) or NVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX 2060 or AMD RX 6600[/p][/*][*][p][b]Storage[/b]: 5 GB available space[/p][/*][*][p][b]Note[/b]: SSD strongly recommended[/p][/*][/list][p]If you’re excited for the demo, [b]wishlist the game[/b]—it helps a lot more than you think.
Thanks for following along, and see you September 1st.[/p]

notes.title: Spaceman Memories is coming to the 2025 Tokyo Indie Games Summit!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44112521/a77e2ca9467ce3728ca9d358856aaf250d28569b.png[/img]

I’m beyond excited to announce that Spaceman Memories has been selected to be part of the 2025 Tokyo Indie Games Summit! This incredible event brings together indie games from around the world, shining a spotlight on creativity and unique storytelling in game development.

The summit will take place on Saturday, March 8 - Sunday, March 9, 2025, in Kichijoji, Tokyo. The first day is dedicated to business and industry networking, while the second day is open to the public. The event will be hosted at Musashino Public Hall and Kichijoji Tokyu REI Hotel, offering an amazing space for indie developers and gaming enthusiasts to connect.

Being part of this showcase is a huge milestone for Spaceman Memories, and I’m honored to see it featured alongside so many talented indie creators. If you're attending, be sure to check it out!

For more details about the event, visit the [url=https://indiegamessummit.tokyo/en/]Tokyo Indie Games Summit Official Website.[/url]

Thank you for your continued support—this journey wouldn’t be possible without you!

Tulio AKA NerdyPunkDev
Spaceman Memories Developer

notes.title: Spaceman Memories selected for the LAGS The Game Awards Edition
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44112521/8171d882567c5d220fcdbaeec14c52448eb7316c.png[/img]

I’m thrilled to announce that Spaceman Memories has been selected to be part of the prestigious Latin American Games Showcase (LAGS), happening alongside The Game Awards 2024! This incredible event, now in its fourth edition, is presented by industry leaders Annapurna, Raw Fury, and ID@Xbox. It celebrates the creativity and talent of game developers across Latin America in a global digital conference.

The showcase will take place on December 10th at 4:00 p.m. PT livestreaming through the Youtube and Twitch of The Game Awards channel and the Latin American Games Showcase Channel. This event will be featuring more than 50 Latin American games from countries including Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Honduras, Venezuela, Paraguay, Uruguay, the Dominican Republic, and Ecuador. 

This milestone is a testament to the creativity and determination that defines our region’s gaming community. I can’t wait for you to experience what we’ve created.

Mark your calendars and join me to watch Spaceman Memories in this wonderful showcase game development to the world stage. Thank you for being part of this journey—it’s your support that makes moments like this possible!

Learn more about the event on the [url=https://x.com/LAGShowcase]LAGS X page[/url]

Thanks for following along,
Tulio AKA [url=www.x.com/nerdypunkdev]NerdyPunkDev[/url]
Spaceman Memories Developer

notes.title: Building Spaceman Memories for the Steam Deck
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44112521/7662a1f8ba887fe4a8b3a6c4b2139749baccc7fd.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone,

A few months ago, I finally got my hands on a Steam Deck. From the start, I knew I wanted to use it as a dev kit for Spaceman Memories, but it’s also been a blast to play on. There’s something special about testing a game you’ve been pouring your heart into on such a unique device—and yes, sneaking in some gaming sessions in between tests has definitely happened.

[previewyoutube=rJx7Hz-nOEs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Testing the Game[/h3]
Right now, Spaceman Memories runs on the Steam Deck as a Windows build using DirectX 11. Thanks to Proton, it works really well, but I’m always on the lookout for ways to improve the experience. Running the game on the Deck has given me a better perspective on things like performance, controls, and UI—elements that feel different when you’re playing on a handheld.

[h3]Aiming for Native Linux[/h3]
While the Windows build works fine, I want to go further. My goal is to release Spaceman Memories as a native Linux build to make the most of the Deck’s SteamOS. This means switching to Vulkan, which takes a bit more work, but it’ll ensure the game feels like it was made for this platform. Plus, there’s something satisfying about knowing the game runs directly on the system without needing a compatibility layer.

[h3]The Fun of Development on Deck[/h3]
Using the Steam Deck as a dev kit has been an interesting balance. On one hand, it’s super convenient—I can test Spaceman Memories directly on the device it’ll be played on. On the other hand, it’s hard not to get distracted by other games (let’s just say it’s a great device for “research”). But even while gaming for fun, I’m always paying attention to how other games handle performance and design for handheld play.

[h3]What’s Next?[/h3]
I’m currently fine-tuning the Windows build to make sure it runs as smoothly as possible on the Deck while working on the transition to a native Linux build. My goal is to make Spaceman Memories not just compatible, but a perfect fit for the Steam Deck. In the upcoming months I will be uploading recorded videos of my Steam Deck running Spaceman Memories so watch out for my social media posts.

If you’re a Steam Deck owner—or just curious—I’d love to hear your thoughts! What do you look for in a handheld experience? Any features you think would make Spaceman Memories shine on the Deck?

Thanks for following along,
Tulio AKA [url=www.x.com/nerdypunkdev]NerdyPunkDev[/url]

notes.title: Spaceman Memories Gameplay trailer released!
notes.content:
I'm excited to share the first official gameplay trailer for Spaceman Memories! Take a glimpse into the world of this 2.5D JRPG, where turn-based combat, intricate puzzles, and a unique journey to recover lost memories come to life.

This trailer offers a sneak peek into the game’s low-poly pixel art style, Japanese-inspired landscapes, and encounters with ancient spirits. Watch now to get a taste of what’s coming!

Check out the trailer, and don’t forget to add Spaceman Memories to your wishlist!
